scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm build:wasm && pnpm -r --filter './examples/**' build && pnpm -r --filter './benchmarks/**' build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.benchmark:transport: pnpm --filter @lume/runtime build && tsdown packages/api/src/benchmark-internals.ts --no-config --format esm --platform node --target es2022 --out-dir benchmarks/transport/node_modules/.lume-api-benchmark --clean && node --expose-gc benchmarks/transport/run.mjs
scripts.benchmark:entity-generation: tsdown packages/runtime/src/benchmark-internals.ts --no-config --format esm --platform node --target es2022 --out-dir benchmarks/.runtime-dist --clean && node --expose-gc benchmarks/entity-generation/run.mjs
scripts.benchmark:assets: pnpm prepare:examples && pnpm --filter @lume/benchmark-assets build && node benchmarks/assets/run.mjs
scripts.test:browser:geometry: pnpm prepare:examples && pnpm --filter @lume/example-geometry-loading build && pnpm test:browser:geometry:built
scripts.test:browser:showcase: pnpm prepare:examples && pnpm generate:showcase-asset && pnpm --filter @lume/example-asset-showcase build && pnpm test:browser:showcase:built
